units.text: Eligibility for VR&E benefits depends on your specific situation.
supporting_chunk_ids: How To Apply For VA Voc Rehab And Employment | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states eligibility depends on situations such as having a disability rating or being in specific programs.

units.text: Generally, you may be eligible if you are a service member or veteran with a service-connected disability and an employment handicap (your disability limits your ability to prepare for, obtain, or maintain suitable employment).
supporting_chunk_ids: How To Apply For VA Voc Rehab And Employment | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context defines employment handicap and eligibility criteria.

units.text: Specific conditions include: if you have a VA disability rating, you can apply through eBenefits;
supporting_chunk_ids: How To Apply For VA Voc Rehab And Employment | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context provides steps for applying with a rating via eBenefits.

units.text: if you're a service member without a rating, you may qualify if you're going through the Physical Evaluation Board process, expect an other than dishonorable discharge with a VA memorandum rating of 20% or more, or are in the Integrated Disability Evaluation System (IDES).
supporting_chunk_ids: How To Apply For VA Voc Rehab And Employment | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context lists these specific situations for service members without a rating.

units.text: Severely injured active-duty members may automatically receive benefits under certain laws.
supporting_chunk_ids: How To Apply For VA Voc Rehab And Employment | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context mentions automatic benefits for severely injured active-duty members under Sec. 1631(b).

units.text: After applying, a Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor will determine if you have an employment handicap and eligibility.
supporting_chunk_ids: How To Apply For VA Voc Rehab And Employment | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states that after applying, a VRC will determine employment handicap and eligibility.

units.text: For more precise guidance, please clarify your current status (e.g., veteran with rating, active duty, etc.).
